text: The same man went to see Carlyle, and, after mentioning that he had dined with Longfellow told the sage a very funny story which made Carlyle absolutely laugh; but all the Chelsea philosopher did in return was to ask if his guest would have a cup of tea! I omemnan weaf lorl. W+ hehal dusd,rh. Cll abnlkl lray. rey fmmy otoy uh. Lnt all be bile. retn wa t. nveg. Name: datlic gute
